_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Redbud (Cercis canadensis). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: Heart-shaped (cordate) leaf + cauliflorous pink flowers blooming directly on bare branches and trunk are unmistakable. Missouri native; frequently multi-trunked and leaning.

plates.caption: Multi-trunked spreading form with heart-shaped leaves; seedpods may be visible.
Pale greenish-yellow autumn foliage (modest fall display).
Scaly grey-brown trunk; note frequent lean / multiple stems. (Spring-bloom plate strongly recommended — the flowering trunk is the defining image.)
